children: Reformation reported second quarter fiscal 2026 net revenue of $155.2 million, an increase of 24.1% year-over-year, and net income of $12.4 million. Adjusted EBITDA grew 53.9% to $25.4 million with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 16.4%. The company recorded gross margin of 66.7% and opened four new stores during the quarter, ending with 70 stores globally.
Net revenue: $155.2 million, up 24.1% vs. Q2 FY2025 ($125.1 million).
Gross profit: $103.5 million with gross margin of 66.7% (230 bps expansion vs. prior-year period).
Income from operations: $19.0 million for the quarter.
Net income: $12.4 million, up 79.4% vs. prior-year period; diluted EPS $0.23.
Adjusted EBITDA: $25.4 million (Adjusted EBITDA margin 16.4%, up 320 basis points).
DTC net revenue grew 21.2% to $135.3 million, driven by a 22.9% increase in Active Customers.
Wholesale and Other net revenue increased 48.7% to $19.9 million, led by higher demand from existing wholesale partners.
International revenue rose 36.8% to $31.2 million, supported by expansion of the retail footprint in France.
Opened four new retail stores during the quarter, bringing the global store count to 70 across the US, UK, Canada and France.
Amended credit agreement on June 17, 2026, securing an additional $92.0 million of term loans and extending maturity to June 2031; proceeds funded an approximately $90.0 million dividend.
